title: Electoral roll eligibility flowchart
subject: Polity
caption: Eligibility decision tree for inclusion in the electoral roll
altText: A flowchart starting at 'Start' and checking age (≥18), citizenship, six‑month residence, and legal disqualification. Paths lead to 'Ineligible' nodes for underage, non‑citizen, insufficient residence, or disqualified, and a final 'Eligible for electoral roll' node when all criteria are satisfied.
